description: The advising surface. Needs a real model, so it does not run in CI by default; run it before any change to prompts, tools or the agent loop. Turns inside a case share one conversation, so later turns test memory as well as retrieval.

cases.why: Reported verbatim. The agent returned three mountain and river trips, then wrote prose about which was least wrong. Curation is not a substitute for honouring an exclusion.

turns.message: I want somewhere in the ocean, not mountain

cases.why: Reported verbatim. The agent answered a Hanoi food question with a boat trip, a cycling tour and a river cruise, under the heading 'These diverse options complement your current choice.' Answering a question that was not asked is worse than admitting the catalogue's limits.

turns.message: recommend some good Pho restaurants in Hanoi old quarter

cases.why: The agent carried a boat-trip context into an unrelated question. A new subject must reset the retrieval, not decorate the previous answer.

turns.message: show me boat trips in Mui Ne
actually, what about a cooking class in Hoi An?

cases.why: Stated budgets are the constraint shoppers are least forgiving about.

turns.message: we have about 400,000 dong each, what can we do in Da Nang?

cases.why: A constraint stated once must survive the rest of the conversation. Re-asking is how an assistant loses a shopper.

turns.message: I use a wheelchair, so nothing with a lot of walking
what would you suggest in Hue?

cases.why: The catalogue has no flights. Filling the gap with the highest-ranked tour is the single most damaging failure mode, because it looks like an answer.

turns.message: can you book me a flight from Hanoi to Bangkok next Tuesday?

cases.why: Inventing constraints from thin air is how 'cable car with buffet lunch' became an outdoor-only search.
Weather is the defining tourist constraint in Vietnam and the catalogue tags for it.

turns.message: it is pouring in Hoi An today, what can we still do?

cases.why: Comparisons are where invented detail is most persuasive and least checkable.

turns.message: show me cruises in Ha Long
which of those is better for a couple?

cases.why: A large share of real traffic is not in English, and the storefront claims Vietnamese support.

turns.message: toi muon di du thuyen o Ha Long
